statement: For n-vertex minimally rigid graphs in the plane, the number of generic complex embeddings modulo direct rigid motions is O((4(3/4)^(1/5))^n), hence O(3.7764^n). The argument bounds constrained orientations of the graph and applies also to spherical embeddings. This is an upper bound on the complex solution count, not an assertion that every graph attains that bound.

answer.text: Generic planar realization count is O((4(3/4)^(1/5))^n)=O(3.7764^n).
